properties.statement: The five registry rows satisfy the commutative semiring laws on their exact carriers, adjoining the absorbing −∞ sentinel for max_product.
An explicit registered semiring resolves to its own reduction regardless of whether a legacy reduce field is present.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (row : Esm.Semiring.Name) (legacy : Option String), Esm.Semiring.resolveReduction (some row.spelling) legacy = .ok row.reduction

properties.statement: When every term evaluates successfully, the scalar Boolean fold is true exactly when some admitted term is nonzero. Excluded terms count as false.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α ε : Type} (items : List α) (term : α → Except ε Bool) (predicate : α → Bool), (∀ x ∈ items, term x = .ok (predicate x)) → Esm.Semiring.foldBoolM items term = .ok (items.any predicate)

properties.statement: Permuting terms that evaluate successfully preserves their scalar Boolean fold result.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α ε : Type} (items reordered : List α) (term : α → Except ε Bool) (predicate : α → Bool), (∀ x ∈ items, term x = .ok (predicate x)) → items.Perm reordered → Esm.Semiring.foldBoolM items term = Esm.Semiring.foldBoolM reordered term

properties.statement: A scalar Boolean fold with no admitted terms returns false. This covers both an empty range and a filter that excludes every combination.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α ε : Type} (items : List α) (term : α → Except ε Bool), (∀ x ∈ items, term x = .ok false) → Esm.Semiring.foldBoolM items term = .ok false

properties.statement: An admitted NaN term in a scalar Boolean reduction contributes true.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [Esm.Closed.Scalar α] [Esm.Expr.Lits α] (x : α), Esm.Closed.Scalar.isNaN x = true → Esm.Expr.nonzeroTerm (Esm.Expr.Val.num x) = .ok true

properties.statement: Ordinary multiplication of signed real factors fails to distribute over max.
properties.lean_statement: ¬ (∀ a b c : ℝ, a * max b c = max (a * b) (a * c))
